# SceneBuilderDragDrop

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/UI/SceneBuilderDragDrop.cs#L15)

Carries a Scene Builder item through Unity's drag and drop system and drops it into the
Scene view or the hierarchy.
The item travels as generic data rather than as an object reference, so Unity's own prefab
drop path never fires alongside ours. That keeps one code path for every item kind, whether
the payload is a prefab, a module install or an AddComponent.
Drops are handled through the GUI callbacks rather than DragAndDrop.AddDropHandler: the
handler registration API is obsolete-as-error in Unity 6000.5 and its V2 replacement has no
public registration method, so the GUI route is the one that works across versions.
